title: CMLL: 93 Aniversario
overview: Maika, Mei Seira & Ema Maishima vs. Sanely, Kira & Candela in a Six Woman Tag Team Match. Blue Panther vs. Jeff Jarrett. Titán (c) vs. Komander for the CMLL World Welterweight Championship. Místico & Averno vs. Templario & Último Guerrero vs. Dragon Rojo Jr. & Bárbaro Cavernario vs. Zandokan Jr. & Star Jr. in a Winners Advance to a Lucha de Apuestas Match. Los Hermanos Chavez (Ángel de Oro & Niebla Roja) (c) vs. Villano III Jr. & El Hijo del Villano III vs. Mascara Dorada & Neon vs. Los Hermanos Calavera (Calavera Jr. I & Calavera Jr. II) in a Four Way Tag Team Match for the CMLL World Tag Team Championship. Soberano Jr. vs. Bandido. Persephone (c) vs. Tessa Blanchard vs. Starlight Kid vs. Mina Shirakawa in a Four Way Match for the CMLL World Women's Championship. Andrade El Idolo vs. Volador Jr.. Hechicero (c) vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Zack Sabre Jr. in a Three Way Match for the CMLL World Heavyweight Championship. TBD vs. TBD in a Lucha de Apuestas Mask vs. Mask Match.
